Plant one seed and you don't get one tomato back.

Kevin Trudeau says a single tomato seed grows into a plant that gives hundreds of tomatoes. He calls this the law of multiplication, and he says giving works the same way.

According to Kevin, when you give support, support comes back, maybe not from the same person. His rule: if you want love in your life, give love first.

Who could you give something to this week without expecting anything back?
